title: Time tracker does not invalidate clock when dynamic epoch floor rises
description: Post-fix correctness review: authoritative current_time/status never revalidate the projected adopted clock against EpochFloorAuthority.current(). A newly accepted provision can raise the floor above current Unix time while status remains valid. Atomically re-evaluate the current projection against the live floor on reads/transitions, invalidate diagnostically, and add provision-raise/concurrency regressions.
